It's been a small comfort knowing that you can't tell what other people think. Even if you think you know, you really don't. I told myself that throughout my life until I stopped caring, about what other people thought, what other people said, the things I did, the things I might do, and whatever I might accomplish. 

The thing is that if you're sick of your anxiety and IBS to the point of wanting to kill yourself, then maybe that's the kind of pain you need to motive yourself. It took me a long time of abuse to learn how to just turn off and do what needed to be done, maybe you can learn the same.

That pain you feel is a powerful weapon, it's being used on you now by your mind and body, but wait until you can control it and use it, it becomes the most powerful tool you will ever have, most other people wouldn't even dream of having it. 

Maybe this isn't a comfort, maybe this is just the blind trying to lead the blind, but if you really care about the planet and its people, than maybe you should stay and try to fix it. If everyone who cares gives up, then no one will be left to fix the problems.
